This notebook describes the game data and how giving changed during the
session, overall, by friendship type and by classroom size.
Code: `code/si/S5_game_and_time.R`. (The classroom bootstrap with 4,999 draws
takes about half a minute.)

```{r s5-setup}
```

## Figure S12 and Table S15. Composition and within-child change

The rise in giving from the first to the final fifth is split into changes
within friendship groups and changes in the mix of groups. Then, within the
same children, we compare the change toward classmates they named with the
change toward the others.

### Change within friendship groups and change in group composition

```{r s5-decomposition}
```

```{r s5-within-child}
```
